Pool Decks

Plan the deck around the pool edge.

Pool shape, existing coping, doors, and yard access all affect the layout. We discuss how much deck space you need, where paths should run, which edges need attention, and how water moves across the area. Paver patterns and material choices depend on the project and the surrounding surfaces.

  • Paver pool decks and pool surrounds
  • Coping, steps, and transitions at the pool edge
  • Walking areas and access points around the pool
  • Borders, cuts, and surface drainage considerations

How the Work Comes Together

The steps for this project.

The pool edge sets many of the decisions for a deck. The layout, access, and surrounding yard are reviewed together.

01

Review the pool area

Discuss the pool shape, existing coping, access from the house, and how much paved space you want around the water.

02

Plan edges and flow

Consider the paver layout, steps, transitions, and how water will move across the deck and adjoining yard.

03

Install the deck

Set the agreed pavers and edge details, finish the connections around the pool, and review the completed area.
